senses.gloss: m. (צָנַם) rock, flint; granite. Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13ᵇ בצ׳ מותר against a neighbor’s granite wall it is permitted; Tosef. ib. I, 4 ובצונן (corr. acc.), contrad. to אבנים ordinary stones.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:12">Num. R. s. 16</cite> <he>הסתכלו … אם של צ׳ וכ׳</he> observe their stones and pebbles, if they are granite-like, the fruits are fat; Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 6.
<cite ref="Niddah 8b:56">Nidd. 8ᵇ</cite> (<he>נמצא בה</he>) <he>צ׳ וכ׳</he> if flint is found in breaking the ground, it is sure to be virgin soil.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 18a:11">B. Bath. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>דמפסיק צ׳</he> a granite block intervenes (preventing the roots from spreading over the neighboring ground).
<cite ref="Pesachim 47b:4">Pes. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ בר זריעה הוא</he> Ms. M. is flinty ground fit for sowing?; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 7:1:5">Y. Kil. VII, beg. 30ᵈ</cite> <he>בהדין צלמא</he> (corr. acc.) in flinty ground, opp. <he>רכיכה</he>; v. <cite ref="Q02194"><he>פִּתְפֵּת</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Berakhot 39a">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>פת צ׳</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="R00633"><he>צָנַם</he></cite>.]
